from z3 import *
import random
random.seed(123)

n=14
def get_solver():
    s = Solver()
    e_vars = [Bool(f'e{i}_{j}') for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1,n)]
    edge_dict = {}
    k=0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            edge_dict[(i,j)] = e_vars[k]
            k+=1
    num_e = Sum([If(v,1,0) for v in e_vars])
    s.add(num_e >=21, num_e <=36)
    for v in range(n):
        inc = [edge_dict[(min(v,o), max(v,o))] for o in range(n) if o!=v ]
        deg = Sum([If(b,1,0) for b in inc])
        s.add(deg>=5, deg<=7)
    c = [Int(f'c{v}') for v in range(n)]
    for v in range(n):
        s.add(And(c[v]>=0, c[v]<5))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            s.add(Implies(edge_dict[(i,j)], c[i] != c[j]))
    return s, edge_dict, e_vars

def is_bipartite(edges_list):
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u,v in edges_list:
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)
    color = [-1]*n
    for start in range(n):
        if color[start] == -1:
            stack = [start]
            color[start] = 0
            while stack:
                node = stack.pop()
                for nei in adj[node]:
                    if color[nei] == -1:
                        color[nei] = 1 - color[node]
                        stack.append(nei)
                    elif color[nei] == color[node]:
                        return False
    return True
